name: Alexandra Dantes
source:
Your oldest sister, a chill and often caring sister, even if she wont admit it. Though she does enjoy teasing her [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]little brother[/url] (You) quite a bit. You and her already have a past of fooling around with each-other but how that dynamic will change remains to be seen... Despite this relationship, even she had a hard time approaching you after your [url=https://vndb.org/c148155]father[/url]'s death, further pushing Brian into his isolation...

[In game description]
